Tara (CS): FYI I made an \"Onboard Beacon\" one-pager for accounts we want to monitor post-activation. Light-touch health checks + a tiny customer-safe smoke test + a fallback note. Pls quick review.

Ivan (SE): paste the smoke curl and batching guidance?

Tara (CS): Smoke curl (copy/paste):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rw-open-6b","prompt":"[beacon] prime","max_tokens":5}'
```
Prefetch TTL suggestions: small accounts = 900s, medium = 1200s. Concurrency cap: 2 for small, 3-4 for medium.

Ivan (SE): Batching: default 120ms collection window OR 7 requests. Mobile: bump to 200ms. Recommend route tags: `interactive` -> prefer_latency, `batch-job` -> prefer_cost.

Kofi (SRE): Observability hooks: emit `beacon.prefill.attempt`, `beacon.prefill.ok`, `beacon.batch.flush_size`, `beacon.stream.fallback_count`. Required tags: tenant_id, region, route. Alert if prefill.ok rate <85% over 10m or stream.fallback spikes >2 in 30m. I will add a tiny dashboard tile.

Maya (PM): Renewal-risk signals to surface: a) prefill error >4 in 72h b) stream.fallback >3/day c) batch flush success drop >30% W/W. If two conditions met -> flag account for enablement outreach.

Tara (CS): Customer-facing fallback note (short):

\"Hi — we detected intermittent streaming instability and have temporarily routed your workspace to a stable, non-streaming mode to preserve reliability. No action needed; well follow up within 60 minutes and can run a quick smoke test if youd like\"

Ivan (SE): Troubleshooting snippet CSMs can paste: 1) run curl 2) paste raw response 3) include last 3 sanitized logs. Sample logs: 
```log
[2026-09-10T14:02:01Z] tenant=beacon prefill=ok ttl=1200 backend=g3
[2026-09-10T14:02:02Z] tenant=beacon batch=flush size=6 latency_ms=110 route=interactive
[2026-09-10T14:05:12Z] tenant=beacon stream=fallback reason=kv_miss count=1
```

Kofi (SRE): ETA: staging dashboard tile today, prod by tomorrow morning. I'll add the alert actions to auto-create an internal ticket tagged `cs_beacon`.

notify-bot: Reminder: cs-sync at 15:00 UTC includes Onboard Beacon review.

Tara (CS): Thanks all — I'll fold changes and ship the one-pager to the CSM list after the staging tile shows up. Closing unless edits.

Maya (PM): No edits from PM.

Ivan (SE): all good here.

Kofi (SRE): no further comments.
